brand_notes: Monitor SE Atom is the entry bookshelf in Paradigm's Monitor SE line (X-PAL dome, 5.5in PP woofer, rear port). Paradigm follows NRC-style directivity (good, parallel curves) but voices the treble hot per ASR (asr-paradigm-monitor-se-atom). Spec pages say 'compatible with 8 ohms' without a nominal rating; measured mins are well below. No QC complaints found.
takeaways: Klippel: LW ±2.1 dB, f3 57 Hz, pref 4.1/6.5, directivity good but on-axis uneven with rising treble
Impedance min 4.5 Ω (below IEC 6.4 Ω floor, not under 4 Ω)
THD ~3.9% near 100 Hz at 96 dB (graph-read); no compression test
ASR could not recommend without EQ; SoundStage!/TONEAudio very positive
Price $399.98/pair at Paradigm; Audio Advice gloss white listed Unavailable
conflicts: Critics call balance natural vs ASR measured/heard bright treble
